## Description

Briefly describe the changes introduced in this pull request and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality or a new component)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 🎨 Design System / Styling polish (CSS tokens, gloss, animations)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Tests / CI improvements

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and design principles of Frutiger.js.
- [ ] I have verified that changes conform to WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility guidelines.
- [ ] I have written tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly.
- [ ] All tests pass locally (`npm run test`).
- [ ] The build succeeds without errors (`npm run build`).
- [ ] No unwanted `any` types were added.
